posts.hook: For the first time in years, supply continuity outranks cost reduction on procurement's 2026 agenda.
posts.key_stat: Supply continuity is procurement's top 2026 objective, surpassing cost reduction (Hackett Group). Supplier enablement is now 1 of 5 core benchmarks across 311 CPOs (GEP).
posts.source: The Hackett Group 2026 Procurement Agenda (via Ironclad); GEP Procurement Metrics That Matter in 2026
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card contrasting continuity rising to #1 over cost reduction, with supplier enablement flagged as a new formal benchmark below.
